## Why This Is Asked

Assesses ability to architect a low-latency, multilingual NLP pipeline at scale, with drift handling and practical rollout considerations.

## Key Concepts

- Streaming architectures (Kafka, Flink/Beam)
- Multilingual, compact models with fast inference
- Latency budgeting and fallback paths for slang
- Drift detection, evaluation, and safe rollout strategies

## Code Example

```python
# Pseudo latency-budgeted inference
import time

def classify(tweet, model, classifier):
    t0 = time.time()
    emb = model.encode(tweet.text)
    pred = classifier.predict(emb)
    latency = time.time() - t0
    return pred, latency
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you detect and respond to model drift in production? Which metrics and thresholds?
- What rollback strategy would you use if latency spikes or drift exceed a limit?

## Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to design a privacy-first, real-time NLP system operating across tenants and languages, with strict data isolation, auditable traces, and integration with Snowflake. Emphasizes latency, robustness to obfuscation, and operations like drift testing and rollback.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time multilingual detection
- Privacy-preserving logging (DP)
- Per-tenant isolation in data stores
- Redaction in streaming path
- Production evaluation (offline metrics, live A/B, rollback)

## Code Example
```python
import re
def redact(text):
  text = re.sub(r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b', '[PII]', text)
  text = re.sub(r'(AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}', '[SECRET]', text)
  return text
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you balance false positives with privacy protection in multilingual settings?
- How would you test redaction quality with adversarial text?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked

Tests ability to design production-ready, multilingual bias-safety systems with latency, privacy, and explainability in real-time chat environments.

## Key Concepts

- Multilingual bias detection
- Counterfactual explanations
- Privacy-preserving auditing
- Drift monitoring and rollout
- On-device + server hybrid architecture

## Code Example

```javascript
function redactPII(text) {
  return text
    .replace(/[a-z0-9._%+-]+@[a-z0-9.-]+\.[a-z]{2,}/gi, "[REDACTED_EMAIL]")
    .replace(/\b(\+?\d{1,3}[-.\s]?)?(\(?\d{3}\)?|\d{3})[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}\b/g, "[REDACTED_PHONE]");
}
```
